title: Member Appeals Program: Appellants, Appealable Denials and the First-Level Filing Limit
content:
Under the Member Appeals Program, an appeal must meet each of the clauses below to be filed. The clauses cover who may file, which denials may be appealed, the time limit for a first-level appeal, and the rule of one undecided appeal per denied record and level.

## Clauses

**1. Who may file.** An appeal may be filed by:

- the member;
- the prescriber; or
- an authorized representative. When the member's package requires an appointment-of-representative form, the representative may file only with that form on file.

**2. What may be appealed.** An appeal may be filed against a denial of a kind the package lists as appealable: a denied coverage review case, a denied formulary exception, or a denied paper claim. An appeal can be filed only for a denial that exists on the member's records. Whether the denial exists is read from the member's records. The appeal is tied to that one denied record.

**3. First-level filing limit.** A first-level appeal must be filed no later than the package's filing limit after the denial notice date. The limit is 180 calendar days under every Northbridge Appeals package. The notice date is day zero, and the date of filing is compared with the last day of the limit. A filing made on the last day itself is in time. A later filing is upheld with the reason "filed late", without review of the merits.

**4. One undecided appeal per denied record and level.** When the package limits each denied record to one undecided appeal per level, an appeal may be filed only when no appeal at the same level for the same denied record is still undecided. An appeal counts as undecided while it has not been upheld, overturned, or withdrawn.

## Boundary of the filing limit (hypothetical dates)

| Denial notice date (day zero) | Date of filing | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 28 August | Day 180 | In time |
| 1 March | 29 August | Day 181 | Late: upheld as filed late, merits not reviewed |

## Points of judgement under clause 4

| Earlier appeal on the same denied record | Same level? | Is it undecided? | Does it bar the new filing? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Filed, no decision, not withdrawn | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Upheld or overturned | Yes | No | No |
| Withdrawn | Yes | No | No |
| Filed, no decision | No (another level) | Yes | No, because only an appeal at the same level is counted |

An appeal on a different denied record is never counted under clause 4.
